facts.fact: Lovable's Quick start says a user can build and publish their first app in about ten minutes.
facts.quote: Build and publish your first app in about ten minutes.

facts.fact: Lovable states that it lets you start for free and that plans are priced by credits rather than by projects or seats.
facts.quote: plans are priced by [credits](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/credits-and-usage), not by projects or seats.

facts.fact: Lovable says you can create a free account using email, Google, GitHub, or Apple.
facts.quote: Create a free account with email, Google, GitHub, or Apple, and start building immediately.

facts.fact: Lovable says a workspace holds projects, members, billing, and a shared pool of credits.
facts.quote: holds projects, members, billing, and a shared pool of credits.

facts.fact: Lovable defines a project as one app, and says each project lives in exactly one workspace.
Lovable says a project's code can be synced to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket through Git sync.
facts.quote: can be synced to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket with [Git sync]

facts.fact: Lovable says the apps it generates include frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations.
facts.quote: generates a working application that includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations

facts.fact: Lovable's Academy offers free video walkthroughs and a guided learning path from the Lovable team.
facts.quote: Free video walkthroughs and a guided learning path from the Lovable team.

facts.fact: Lovable says users can remix its ready-made app templates on any plan.
facts.quote: Start from a ready-made app you can remix on any plan.
